content.title: Who Is Duke Coach Jon Scheyer’s Wife? All About Marcelle Scheyer
content.text: NEED TO KNOWDuke University basketball coach Jon Scheyer first met wife Marcelle Scheyer when they were both attending the college in 2010The couple got married in 2017They share three children, including daughter Noa and sons Jett and JamesJon Scheyer and his wife, Marcelle Scheyer, began their love story at Duke — and the college still plays a huge role in their lives together today.The couple met while attending the North Carolina-based university in 2010, and Jon popped the question five years later in 2015. Two years later, they wed in a private Chicago ceremony — not far from Jon's hometown of Northbrook, Ill.Jon and Marcelle's family grew in 2018 with the birth of their first child, daughter Noa Marie. The following year, they welcomed their son Jett James and another son named James Russell, in 2022 — roughly a year after Jon was named the 20th head coach of Duke men's basketball, which is currently competing in the 2026 NCAA March Madness Tournament.Throughout his coaching career, Marcelle has been spotted behind the bench at Duke games when she's not working as a registered nurse in Durham, N.C.So who is Jon Scheyer's wife? Here's everything to know about Marcelle Scheyer and her relationship with Duke's head basketball coach.She's from FloridaJon Scheyer and Marcelle Scheyer pose for a photo together in May 2014.Credit: Jon Scheyer/ InstagramBorn on June 5, 1987, Marcelle was raised in Florida before moving to North Carolina for graduate school. She told WRAL in December 2023 that she didn't grow up in a sports family."The whole sports world was new to me," Marcelle told the outlet.She’s a nurseJon Scheyer and Marcelle Scheyer take in a photo together.Credit: Jon Scheyer/ InstagramMarcelle graduated from Duke with a master's in nursing in 2016 and now works as a family nurse practitioner."I've always been interested in health care and clinical research," she told WRAL.She and Jon wed in 2017Jon Scheyer and his wife in June 2018.Credit: Jon Scheyer/InstagramJon and Marcelle met in 2010, but they didn't make their relationship Instagram official until 2014, when the now-head coach posted a photo of the couple after his first Duke game as the team's special assistant.A year later, he proposed to Marcelle, who was speechless when the relationship milestone happened."She said YES!!! We are engaged! Thanks to all the love from our family and friends," Jon wrote on Instagram alongside a photo of them after the special moment.The couple married on May 6, 2017, and celebrated Marcelle's 30th birthday a month later."Happy Birthday to my WIFE! So lucky to be by your side!" Jon wrote on Instagram. "Thank you for being the most unselfish, fun, caring, loving wife! 30 looks great on you!!! Love you!"She and Jon have three kidsJon Scheyer and wife Marcelle Scheyer with their children in January 2020.Credit: Jon Scheyer/ InstagramThe couple are proud parents to three children. They welcomed their first child and only daughter, Noa Marie, on Jan. 29, 2018, and Jon shares a birthday with their second child, son Jett James, who arrived on Aug. 24, 2019.Jon and Marcelle later welcomed their third child, son James Russell, on May 18, 2022.The Duke head coach has previously shared on Instagram that he's "amazed every day by the love, care [and] attention" Marcelle shows their kids.Marcelle also considers herself a "mom of the [Duke] basketball team," telling WRAL, "I just want to wrap them [up] and keep them safe. There's so much that they are exposed to. They're young and amazing guys."She says watching Jon coach at Duke is a "dream come true"Jon Scheyer and Marcelle Scheyer together in April 2017.Credit: Jon Scheyer/ InstagramMarclle couldn't be prouder of her husband, who dedicated 12 years of his life to the Duke men's basketball program before being named head coach in June 2021.Jon played at Duke for four years, leading the Blue Devils to a national championship as a senior in 2010. Over the next three years, he ventured into professional basketball, playing in the NBA Summer League and overseas in Europe.In 2013, Jon officially joined the coaching staff at his alma mater."I just want to thank my family. My wife, Marcelle, we've been on an incredible journey together. I can't wait for this next chapter of our lives," Jon said during his first press conference as head coach.While speaking to WRAL, Marcelle told the outlet that she hopes Jon coaches at Duke "forever," similar to his predecessor Mike "Coach K" Krzyzewski, who served as head coach for 42 seasons."Seeing Jon in his element and coaching at the best place in the world, in my opinion, has been a dream come true," she said.They created the Scheyer Family Kid Captain ProgramMarcelle Scheyer after presenting a basketball signed by coach Scheyer to Samantha DiMartino on February 28, 2024 in Durham, North Carolina.Credit: Jon Scheyer/ InstagramDuring the 2022–23 season, Jon and Marcelle launched the Scheyer Kid Captain program. The partnership with Duke Children's Hospital invites patients and their families to spend a game day with the team.Kids of the program attend the player's game day shootaround and get to play on Duke's famous Cameron court before being honored during a first-half media timeout.Marcelle told the Associated Press that it's "inspiring" to witness the "strength" of the patients and their families.“I definitely get teary-eyed and choked up,” she said about joining the kids at center court. “I’m such an emotional [person], especially when it comes to kids. What these parents and families are going through, it’s just unthinkable."Marcelle continued, "I feel so honored to lead this program. I wish we could do it a million times over."Read the original article on People
